newsitem.title: USA: Nimbus CD sees Q2 shr below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Nimbus CD sees Q2 shr below expectations.

text.p: Nimbus CD International Inc said Tuesday it expects earnings per share for the second quarter of FY97 ending September 30 to be relatively flat compared to pro forma earnings per share of $0.15 for the second quarter of FY96.
The company said these results will be slightly below analysts' expectations for the current quarter.

The company said its CD-ROM business for the second quarter is above internal projections, but inventories of CD-Audio products at retail outlets remain high and fall re-order rates are slower than expected.
Because of these factors the CD-Audio business will be relatively flat compared to last year's second quarter and be below internal budgets for the current year, the company said.

The company also said that the diskette and related services of Nimbus Software Services Inc have not performed to expectations and that the diskette duplication business has declined more quickly than industry expectations.
The company said, however, that its busy season is about to begin and that it believes it will "post solid growth in earnings and profitability as compared to last year."
